description: This file defines the RetrieveThing class, a final immutable command class that retrieves a 'Thing' based on its ID in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods for creating instances from JSON, building commands with specific parameters, and includes nested Builder class for constructing retrieve commands.

classes.name: RetrieveThing
classes.description: Command class to retrieve a specific Thing by its ID, with support for selected fields and snapshot revisions. It includes factory methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and a nested Builder class for constructing instances.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a RetrieveThing command instance for a given ThingId and headers. Deprecated overload allows creation with a CharSequence ThingId.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a RetrieveThing command from a JSON string or object, with specified headers.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder to construct a RetrieveThing command with specified ThingId and headers.

methods.name: getSelectedFields
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the selected JSON fields to retrieve.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing to be retrieved.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path for the resource (empty in this case).

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes command data into a JSON object, including thing ID, selected fields, and snapshot revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new RetrieveThing instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: getSnapshotRevision
methods.description: Returns an Optional Long representing the snapshot revision if set.
